search.website_text:
Create your own slash commands.
# 🛠️ CreateXIV [![CreateXIV Downloads Count](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Fkamori.goats.dev%2FPlugin%2FDownloadCounts&query=%24.CreateXIV&label=&style=plastic&color=gold)](https://kamori.goats.dev/Plugin/DownloadCounts)[![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/badge/-Downloads-lightgrey?style=plastic)](https://kamori.goats.dev/Plugin/DownloadCounts) ### Create custom slash commands with ease. [![Verified Plugin - Dalamud](https://img.shields.io/badge/✔%20Verified%20Plugin-Dalamud-red?style=for-the-badge)](#) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Bryer-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discordapp.com/users/896449611168874507) [![AGPL-3.0 License](https://img.shields.io/badge/⚖️%20License-AGPL--3.0-636e72?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/seventity7/CreateXIV?tab=AGPL-3.0-1-ov-file) CreateXIV is a Dalamud plugin for that allows players to create custom slash commands with ease. It combines the flexibility of macros with the power of plugin commands, all through a clean in-game interface.
### 📌 Summary [![Features](https://img.shields.io/badge/✨%20Features-View-00b894?style=flat-square)](#features) [![Installation](https://img.shields.io/badge/🔧%20Installation-Guide-0984e3?style=flat-square)](#installation) [![How It Works](https://img.shields.io/badge/🧠%20How%20It%20Works-Read-6c5ce7?style=flat-square)](#how-it-works) [![Important Rules](https://img.shields.io/badge/⚠️%20Important%20Rules-Check-d63031?style=flat-square)](#important-rules) [![Future Plans](https://img.shields.io/badge/🚀%20Future%20Plans-Roadmap-fdcb6e?style=flat-square)](#future-plans) [![Author](https://img.shields.io/badge/👩‍💻%20Author-Bryer-00cec9?style=flat-square)](#author) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/⚖️%20License-Info-636e72?style=flat-square)](#license) ---
### ✨ Features

📝 Alias Creation

Create custom slash command aliases and execute them directly through the in-game chat.

While creating commands/macros alias, you can create (or use existing) categories for them with it own color.

🫂 Support

Use aliases for personal macros, shared macros, plugin commands and native game commands.

Example: Alias /mv Command: /mastervolume = /mv executes /mastervolume

🧩 Organization

Keep aliases clean with favorites, categories, filters, search and import/export tools.

🖥️ In-Game UI

Manage everything ingame using the plugin window opened with /create.
### Supported/Available ![Plugin Commands](https://img.shields.io/badge/Plugin%20Commands-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Game Commands](https://img.shields.io/badge/Game%20Commands-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Command Chain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Command%20Chain-✘-red?style=flat-square) ![Game Macros](https://img.shields.io/badge/Macro%20Aliases-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Shared Macros](https://img.shields.io/badge/Shared%20Macros-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Macro Chain](https://img.shields.io/badge/Macro%20Chain-✘-red?style=flat-square) ![Import/Export](https://img.shields.io/badge/Import%20%2F%20Export-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Enable/Disable](https://img.shields.io/badge/Enable%20%2F%20Disable-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Create through chat](https://img.shields.io/badge/Create%20Via%20Chat-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Command List](https://img.shields.io/badge/Command%20List-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Delay](https://img.shields.io/badge/Delay-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square) ![Mass Actions](https://img.shields.io/badge/Mass%20Actions-✘-red?style=flat-square) ![Edit](https://img.shields.io/badge/Edit-✔-brightgreen?style=flat-square)
---
### 🔧 Dalamud Installation | Step | Action | | --- | --- | | 1️⃣ | Open the Dalamud plugin list with `/xlplugins` | | 2️⃣ | Search for `CreateXIV` | | 3️⃣ | Click **Install** | | 4️⃣ | Enable the plugin | | ✔ | Open the main window or type `/create` |
> [!TIP] > CreateXIV is intended to be installed through the ingame Dalamud plugin installer only. --- ### 🧠 How It Works ### 🪟 Main Window CreateXIV allows you to define aliases that point to commands or macros. --- ### 🔹 Alias → Command > [!NOTE] > Use this when you want a shorter custom command to execute a longer command. **Example:** | Alias | Command | | --- | --- | | `Golem` | `/Example Dynamis Golem` | Typing this in chat: ```txt /Golem ``` Executes: ```txt /Example Dynamis Golem ``` --- ### 🔹 Alias → Macro > [!NOTE] > Use this when you want an alias to execute a macro from your in-game macro list. **Example:** | Alias | Macro | | --- | --- | | `Golem` | `macro:45` | Typing this in chat: ```txt /Golem ``` Executes: ```txt Macro 45 ``` --- ### 🔹 Categories/Favorites While creating command or macro aliases, you can create new categories or use existing ones. Categories can have their own color. You can also pin/favorite an alias to keep it at the top of the list. ---
### ⚠️ Important Rules | Rule | Status | | --- | --- | | Do **not** use `/` in alias names | ❌ Invalid | | Macro/Command chains are not supported | ❌ Unavailable | | Always use `/` in the command field for plugin commands | ✅ Required | | You can't create an alias named `create` | ❌ Reserved | | You can't point an alias command to `/create` | ❌ Reserved | | Duplicate alias names overwrite existing entries | 🔁 Expected | | The macro must exist in-game | ✅ Required | | Macro content is managed inside FFXIV, not inside the plugin | ℹ️ Note |
> [!IMPORTANT] > These rules help prevent command conflicts and invalid alias behavior. ---
### 🚀 Future Plans

### What's New?
- Added support for disabling alias execution delay
- Updated the per-alias `Wait` range to `0-5` seconds
- Added new `/create list` command
  - Shows all created aliases and their linked commands/macros in chat

### Notes
- Default `Wait` value for new Aliases is now `0`
- Updated `Readme` on plugin github page
